name: Seedance 2.0 Reference To Video
description: Seedance 2.0 Reference To Video is available in the Business API catalog.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

duration.description: Video length in seconds (4-15), or 'auto' to let the model choose.
duration.title: Duration

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark to the output video.
watermark.title: Watermark

bitrate_mode.description: Output encode bitrate. 'high' produces a larger, higher-bitrate file; defaults to 'standard'.
bitrate_mode.title: Bitrate Mode

image_urls.description: Up to 9 reference images (referenced in the prompt as @Image1...).
image_urls.title: Image Urls

video_urls.description: Up to 3 reference videos (referenced in the prompt as @Video1...). Each must be mp4 or mov, 2-15 seconds long, at most 200 MB, 24-60 fps; the reference videos total at most 15 seconds.
video_urls.title: Video Urls

audio_urls.description: Up to 3 reference audio clips (referenced in the prompt as @Audio1...). Each must be wav or mp3, 2-15 seconds long, at most 15 MB; the clips total at most 15 seconds.
audio_urls.title: Audio Urls
